items.title: Christian Kirk: Walks off with trainer
items.body_text: Kirk walked off with an apparent injury during the 49ers' practice Sunday, Matt Barrows of The Athletic reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jacoby Brissett: Agrees to new deal with Arizona
items.body_text: Brissett and the Cardinals agreed to a reworked contract Sunday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Ty Simpson: Agrees to rookie contract
items.body_text: Simpson agreed to terms on a four-year, $25.4 million rookie contract with the Rams on Saturday, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brandon Aiyuk: Remains on left squad list
items.body_text: San Francisco general manager John Lynch told reporters Saturday that Aiyuk (knee) will remain on the 49ers' reserve/left squad list, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: George Kittle: Starting training camp on PUP
items.body_text: The 49ers placed Kittle (Achilles) on the active/PUP list Saturday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports. Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
